limitations: The deterministic validator checks package identity and declared traceability; it cannot judge prose quality or discover every unregistered semantic claim.
Only JSON scalar locators receive deterministic content comparison; non-JSON locators still require independent semantic review.
Revision and rebuttal validation checks prior-document identity, reviewer-comment identity, and response presence; complete point-by-point response coverage still requires independent review.
Venue requirements and reporting-guideline interpretation still require current authoritative instructions and expert judgment.
The acceptance package is a deterministic software fixture, not a scientific manuscript or publication claim.
